tools.name: caclulus_area_under_curve
tools.description:
Calculate the definite integral (signed area) or geometric
area under a curve using Simpson's 1/3 rule.
Supported functions: x, x^2, x^3, sin(x), cos(x), exp(x), sqrt(x).

tools.name: generate_java_algorithm
tools.description: Generate a Java implementation of a supported mathematical algorithm. This returns fixed, reviewed templates and does not execute generated code.

tools.name: prime_analyze
tools.description: Check whether an integer is prime and return its prime factorization. Supports integers from -10^12 through 10^12; prime status is defined only for n >= 2.

tools.name: common_base_multiply
tools.description: Multiply two integers using the Common-Base Multiplication Method: x=N+a, y=N+b, xy=N^2+N(a+b)+ab. Returns the chosen base, offsets, terms, and exact result.
